description: New direct update system: Settings → Updates checks updates.json on GitHub, shows what's new first, and updates only after you approve — code only, data untouched.
features: Direct version check via updates.json — no GitHub releases needed.
Check shows the description and new features before anything updates.
Separate Update now button — nothing updates without your approval.
Code-only updates with live progress — user data is never touched.
New mandatory rule: agents update this file on every big update.
